key_insight: Agentic Symbolic Search (ASYS) uses a prior-guided agent plus evolutionary and gradient-based optimization to discover interpretable symbolic PDE representations instead of only numerical or neural approximations.
engineering_relevance: The method could help engineers obtain compact, human-readable surrogate laws for complex PDE systems, improving insight, downstream analysis, and model-guided design.
method: Agent translates PDE theory, problem constraints, and prior search experience into differentiable symbolic programs.
Evolutionary search refines the mathematical form while gradient descent fits continuous parameters.
Acts as inductive-bias injection for symbolic discovery rather than blind symbolic regression.
evidence_signal: Across five PDE problems, including bounded dynamics, finite-time blow-up, and free-boundary focusing, ASYS recovered known analytical forms or produced new interpretable formulas such as an Allen-Cahn interface law and a Keller-Segel contraction law.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality of provided priors, constraints, and search setup, so results could be sensitive to problem-specific guidance.
paper_title: Agentic Symbolic Search: Characterizing PDEs Beyond Hand-crafted Expressions, Meshes, and Neural Networks
